title: Multivariate Hermite polynomial
statement: Let $n\ge 0$ and let $\alpha=(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)$ be a tuple of nonnegative integers. The multivariate Hermite polynomial indexed by $\alpha$ is the product $\prod_{i=1}^n H_{\alpha_i}(x_i)/\sqrt{\alpha_i!}$, where $H_j/\sqrt{j!}$ is the normalized Gaussian Hermite polynomial of degree $j$.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ assigns a natural number to each of the $n$ coordinates
